lenses.name: Alpha interface and test surface
lenses.guide: Review whether the alpha extension's tests and product cross the same intentional interface. There is no backward-compatibility requirement. Distinguish the external seam used by Pi from internal seams used by implementation tests. Look for test-only dependencies, options, helpers, or exports that leaked into the external interface only to make internals callable. Apply the deletion test and replace-don't-layer rule: prefer deleting an external concept and keeping a small internal test seam over adding another wrapper or abstraction. Preserve all current user-visible compaction, fallback, replay, timeline, and status behavior. Report one global simplification that improves test leverage and maintenance locality. Do not request more mocks, types, coverage, files, dependency injection, or a test framework. Do not report a local assertion or style issue.
